title: Azure SQL database
description: Azure SQL logical server with one database. Entra ID is the only sign-in method (no SQL passwords exist), TLS 1.2, encryption at rest, closed to the internet by default, optional private endpoint.
security_defaults: Entra ID-only authentication: no SQL administrator password is ever created
Public network access off; TLS 1.2 minimum; transparent data encryption on

entra_admin_login.description: Display name or UPN of the Entra user or group that administers the server.

entra_admin_object_id.description: Object ID of that Entra user or group.

sku_name.description: Size. GP_S_* is serverless (pauses when idle), GP_* provisioned general purpose, BC_* business critical.

max_size_gb.description: Maximum data size in GB (omit for the SKU default; Basic allows 2 at most).

auto_pause_minutes.description: Serverless only: minutes of inactivity before pausing; -1 never pauses.

zone_redundant.description: Spread replicas across availability zones (not for Basic/Standard).

backup_retention_days.description: Point-in-time restore window (Basic allows 7 at most).

public_network_access_enabled.description: Reachable from the internet. Leave false and use a private endpoint.

private_endpoint_subnet_id.description: Subnet for a private endpoint to the server.

private_dns_zone_id.description: privatelink.database.windows.net zone for the private endpoint.
